message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight for booking number 1234, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly we need to book flight? But they just want to check options and estimate total payable amount. So we can compute cost. We might need to authenticate? For get_flight_cost, no authentication needed. So we can call get_flight_cost. But we need to get list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. Also maybe we need to consider insurance? Not requested. So just cost.

Thus steps: call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then respond with estimated total payable amount.

We need to call list_all_airports.
